cold_start_contract: First actual read constructs the OCR engine. ORT/RapidOCR and production module imports are measured separately above, never silently added into each frame.
cache_contract: Each actual forced read is followed by one unforced same-byte read. External wall time measures cache cost; cached elapsed_ms is the original computation, not cache time.
accounting_contract: Inclusive method totals are nested, not additive. Exclusive method totals subtract immediate-child intervals and sum to the Perception.read interval. Direct RapidOCR calls retain image shape, detection mode and caller. Missing private shop/state assets remain unknown; no synthetic shop or confidence injection.
